steps: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F). Line a baking sheet with foil and spray with non-stick cooking spray.

In a large bowl, combine ground beef, egg, breadcrumbs, parmesan, onion, garlic, salt, pepper, and parsley (if using). Mix until just combined. If needed, add a tablespoon of milk to keep the mixture wet.
Scoop and form into ~4 cm (1 1/2-inch) balls. Place on baking sheet.
Bake uncovered for 17–20 minutes, turning halfway through, until no longer pink in the middle.
Optional: simmer cooked meatballs in marinara sauce for 10 minutes.
Serve as-is or over pasta; top with parmesan and fresh herbs if desired.
